**Implementation:** unmodified upstream `github.com/hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b2c7e889f31e5ab2f7ed90ceb159acffe`), verified byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache; no implementation file perturbed in the work copy.

**Executed evidence:** full suite passes except 17 socket-blocked TCP tests; full suite and targeted `-race` stress (leadership transfer, pre-vote, concurrent apply, snapshot/barrier/verify-leader) show zero data races; `gofmt`/`go vet` clean; four independent audit tests all green including under `-race` (crash/restart convergence; deposed-leader uncommitted-entry drop; randomized acknowledged-entry safety + Log Matching Property; socketless transport). Consensus core, FSM loop, API contracts, and transport layer were read line-by-line against the Raft spec.

**Explained, not a defect:** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` (~2/40, test-timing; 60/60 clean without `-race`).

**Environment-blocked coverage:** literal TCP tests and the `fuzzy` linearizability module.
